text_block_list.text: One early afternoon, with Sounds of Earth's debut race drawing near—
As I headed to the track for training, a familiar sound of a violin reached my ears...
choice_data_list: (...I wonder if Earth is playing again?)

text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—Bravo! Splendid as always, Earth-kun!
Your playing was filled with more emotion than ever!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, when do you practice the violin?
You even have your debut race coming up, it's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, because to me, living
is itself music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: The blossoms that enrich our expression are budding all around us.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Remarkable.
I must follow that admirable spirit as well...!

...Sounds of Earth was having
a pleasant chat with two Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Direttore!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Oh, Direttrice!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you're here, that means—
Ah, is it that time already?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
Did I keep you waiting?
choice_data_list: No, I just got here myself.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Now that Earth's Trainer is here, maybe we should be heading out soon too.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Earth, let's both do our best in our debuts!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the performance. See you later.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Grazie!
May wonderful music be with you both as well!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! A beloved schoolmate,
and a fellow performer standing upon the same turf!

Hearing "the same era" jogged my memory.
I had thought the two looked somewhat familiar—

Those two are Umamusume debuting this year,
just like Sounds of Earth...
In other words, they are her 'classmates'...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. Every one of those girls
harbors a magnificent melody deep within them.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Take Peerless Shout, for instance,
with her calm and somewhat quiet demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It seems her Trainer will be retiring
due to age before long—"

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: "—Trainer is the oldest veteran at the Academy, but..."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: “They're gentle and always look out for their Umamusume. They've been really good to me, too.”

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"However, Trainer-san has never won
the Japanese Derby with one of their trainees."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
"Before my Trainer retires...
I want to deliver that dream to them."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: "The title of Derby Trainer...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—Beeeellllissima!!
What magnificent passion...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The flames dwelling in those eyes. I can hardly wait
to see what melody they will carve into the turf...!
choice_data_list: I see, so you have a dream like that...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: “—The other Aurum Star, whose bearing is so powerful and heroic, possesses ambition...!”

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: "My family pedigree is, well... a bit distant from racing, you see."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"Back when I first aspired to enter the racing world...
there were voices saying I'd never amount to anything, too."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"'You have other duties to attend to.
That is what you were raised for,'—they went as far as saying that to me——"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: “Don't you think it's a laughable story, Earth-kun?”

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"‘Look at history. Though few in number,
there are certainly Umamusume who blossomed
despite their birth and circumstances.’"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: "How can you say for certain that I'll never become like them? ...Nonsense."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...Thus, you shall prove it.
With your own running, your inner canzone."

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
"'Song'......... Yeah, that's right.
I'll make myself resonate across a grand stage everyone acknowledges!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"—Brrriiiillllante!!
I would dearly love to hear your song of triumph...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: "The light of that dream shines like a radiant star—destined to dazzle upon the stage of the turf...!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Not just them. Every single one of my peers
harbors burning passions of their own...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
And those very feelings...!
They become a unique, one-of-a-kind melody—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Create the ultimate session!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
How thrilling...!!
...Just like the music she played, there was a powerful magnetism felt in the way Sounds of Earth spoke.
In fact, I myself am thrilled to see what kind of races Sounds of Earth and her generation will show us moving forward...!
choice_data_list: …You really do pay close attention to the other girls, don’t you?
...You really pay close attention to the girls around you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! For we are musicians
standing together on the stage called "Now"—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"As someone who strives for the ultimate session,
I must understand everyone's finest music and the
background from which that music is born!"
The passion in Sounds of Earth's eyes... I couldn't help but let out a gasp of admiration at its brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, Direttore!
Let us begin our training for today!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, Direttrice!
Let us begin our training for today!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: All to turn your once-in-a-lifetime debut race into a fantastico session!
Afterward, a fully pumped-up Sounds of Earth and I went through final adjustments for her debut race...!

And so, as the days spent with
Sounds of Earth went by—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: —It's almost time. Get ready, please.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
...Even so, everyone seems pretty nervous.
Is it always like this?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“She's just that kind of Umamusume.
Whenever you share a room with her,
you can't help but want to sit up straight—”
—Halt.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Good work, everyone.
—At ease."

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
So that's the "Gilded Tyrant," Orfevre—
What an incredible aura...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Wait, you...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I-I'm so sorry...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Very well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Be scorched by my majesty and spread its brilliance far and wide.
That is your duty—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural to be enraptured by the gold that parts the darkness.
Therefore, I permit it.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Hear this clearly.
What I declare now is the compass for my path of supremacy."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I shall head to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe once more.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And then, I shall reclaim it.
The seat at the summit, where I rightfully belong.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Entrust it to this king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Your dreams. Desires. Regrets. Pride. Wrath. Prayers.
Surrender every last one of them to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall make them all the foundation.
Cornerstones for my victory, my glory—
(Oooooohhhhh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text: —Orfevre's press conference the other day really was something else. Now that's all anyone can talk about everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
It's no surprise. Her charisma is on an entirely different level.
A presence distinct from Symboli Rudolf's, one so overwhelming it could almost be called violent...

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the one who will ultimately stand at the pinnacle
is our radiant 'Gentildonna.'
............Speak of the devil, she's here!”

—To one and all,
I bid you good day.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all very much
for gathering here for me today.

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text: Ooh...! As dignified and resolute as always—

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text:
Now that is the true presence of a Triple Tiara champion...!
The strongest of our era, our very own Gentildonna-sama...!

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee B
text_block_list.text:
Um, Lady Gentildonna!
Your race in Dubai was simply magnificent!
...I mean, even if you didn't finish in first place—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"—No, the result was 'defeat.'
Nothing more, nothing less."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I have no words to offer in excuse.
I have exposed nothing but shameful, utter disgrace."

text_block_list.name: Party Attendee A
text_block_list.text: Lady Gentildonna...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —All the more reason why.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall wash away the blemish.
With an overpowering, absolute majesty that exceeds it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
With even greater strength. With supreme, peerless might.
Let us simply pile up victory upon victory.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And I shall show everyone present.
Through the tracks of my hooves, who the truly strong one is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: For the time being, victory at next year's Dubai International G1. And also—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Uncharted territory. I promise right here and now
that I will achieve back-to-back victories in the Japan Cup.
(Ooooohhhh...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
—I-I finally caught up to you...!
Gold Ship-san!!
Could we talk a bit about our upcoming races...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? The distortion in the Earth's axis isn't here?!
What is the meaning of this, My Earth!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Vrrroooom... West... Vrrroooom...
Ring... Hanshin... Ring...——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap, I gotta fix the coordinates right now!
At this rate, my grilled squid is gonna turn into
grilled Dagon...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...?
Gold Ship-san...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll leave the rest to you!
Remember, make sure it's warmed to body temperature before drinking it, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, ah, wait—!?
Th-Thank you!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOH!!
Like I'd ever rely on glitches!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: ...Why was I handed plain hot water...?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"—The Twinkle Series is generating massive excitement
again this year! Fans just can't keep their
eyes off their favorite star Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Male Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"We have high hopes for this, folks!
Orfevre's revenge at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
Will Japan's long-cherished dream finally come true!?"

text_block_list.name: Female Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"I'm still backing Gentildonna!
If Orfevre is focusing on overseas campaigns,
won't this year basically be her stage alone?"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Well, we've got Gold Ship this year!
She's completely unpredictable...!
I'm sure she'll fire everyone up with an unconventional race—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Our program will continue to follow their movements—"

"Lately, the media had been covering the feats of the generation
above Sounds of Earth day after day in a frenzy of excitement."

"We are currently in a rare era where many Umamusume
making historic achievements have gathered together."

"It is only natural for racing fans
to be drawn to such tremendous brilliance."
I will definitely bring Sounds of Earth to those heights as well.
The ultimate session she strives for must surely lie at the very center of the era...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: “—Your eyes are exceptionally appassionato today, Direttore.”
choice_data_list: I just psyched myself up again.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: “—Your eyes are exceptionally appassionato today, Direttrice.”
choice_data_list: I just psyched myself up again.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo!
I shall rise to match that energia of yours!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's begin today's session!
Our ensemble starts now!!
Sounds of Earth's debut race is right around the corner...!
